title: 第3章 护君打江山第4章 派去剿土匪
slug: 快穿之时空星河伴第九章误闯雾山
content_zh:
昔小苑和沐梓丞已经传输到达世界，昔小苑睁开眼扫视着这周围的环境，这是一个古色古香的一个房间，屋内冉冉升起一缕烟，而且还是香香的，这应该就是香薰吧。
沐梓丞一穿梭到这里，他就有种不祥的预感…昔小苑坐在床上，而后又仔细的打量了下沐梓丞，他穿着一身淡蓝色的衣裳，这衣服好好看哦，飘飘然的感觉，他头发上的发冠好精致哦~银白色的，中间还有个淡蓝色的宝石，好看好看。
据现在这种让人觉得梦幻不敢相信的狗带情况来分析…这人一看就是个古代人，不过这皮肤可真嫩呀，长得可真是.....昔小苑口水都要出来了，纯天然美人，真真是个美男子呀。
哎哟喂～看的她哈喇子都差点出来了。
沐梓丞感受到了一束猥琐的目光，便看见昔小苑跟个大街上的痞子一样看着他，而且口水都快流出来，这女人也太猥琐了吧。
沐梓丞一脸高冷的看着昔小苑说道：“看够了吗？一脸的猥琐。”
昔小苑翻了个白眼说道：“你是哪代朝代的人？”
沐梓丞说道：“吾来着浮泽大陆，吾还没问你是哪国的人呢。”
昔小苑突然抬头挺胸高傲的说道：“我来自一个科技发达的时代，你说的那个浮泽大陆我没听说过。”
沐梓丞一脸的疑惑，随后又有些无语的看着昔小苑的衣服说道：“科技发达？这是何世界？而且你这衣服穿得可真是，非礼勿视。”
昔小苑看着自己的礼服，没啥毛病，不过对于他这个古人来说问题还挺大的。
“这叫时尚，反正你是不会懂得了。”
沐梓丞一脸嫌弃的说道：“吾才不想懂你这俗人的什么时尚。”
昔小苑叹了口气的说道：“行吧，不是同一个世界的就是有点代沟呀，有机会让你看看我们那边的世界吧，反正很厉害很厉害……”
沐梓丞眉头一挑的说道：“这样吗？吾还有点兴趣看看你说的到底有多厉害~”
昔小苑一脸嘚瑟的说道：“保证让你大开眼界……”
“人物植入开始......”
系统就这么突然一声不响的来一句，昔小苑身上开始出现变化，身上的礼服变成了一件古风的衣服，头发也扎了起来，昔小苑跑到铜镜上照了照自己的样子。
头发上带着一个白色的发冠，而且有绿色的翡翠点缀着，头发扎的干净利落，衣服手感很好，柔和舒服，而且设计的很好看，这衣服颜色是翠绿色的，除了领子一些部分是白色的，而且这衣服上的花纹单调好看又不失高雅。
棒！昔小苑在铜镜前转了一圈。

沐梓丞冷不丁的冒出一句说道：“臭美，怎么照都丑。”
昔小苑一个冷冷的眼神瞪过去说道：“你才丑呢，小心我一脚就过去，咱们能一起做任务就说明我们有缘分，而且以后还得一起做很多的任务呢，那咱们现在就是搭档，作为搭档的你你是不是要积点口德捏？！””
沐梓丞‘切’了一声就不搭理昔小苑了，然而昔小苑发现沐梓丞没有影子....我去，他什么情况，而且她发现铜镜里没有他的身影。
昔小苑说话都有点结巴了的说道：“你....你没有影子，而且镜子里看不到你的身影…我去，你是个鬼啊～难道我以后跟着…没有影子的人一起做任务？！”
昔小苑感觉冷嗖嗖的。
沐梓丞突然转过头冷冷的瞪了昔小苑一眼，眉头一皱的立马走到镜子前看看，还真是，镜子里看不到他的人，只看到旁边这女人。
沐梓丞语气很不好的对周围喊道：“时空管理者你给吾出来！！”
系统冒了出来立马解释道：“别着急别着急，我知道你要问什么，你因为消耗了法力你身体受到了一定的伤害，所以本系统拟不到假身份给你，而且这只是暂时的。”
昔小苑听到系统这么一说偷偷的在旁边偷笑着。
沐梓丞瞥了昔小苑一个冷眼，昔小苑看沐梓丞这么凶的看着她，她便做了个鬼脸给沐梓丞看，像是在幸灾乐祸一样。
沐梓丞冷冷的看着系统，好像要吃了它似的说道：“为何她就有。”
系统打着哈哈一笑的说道：“你俩情况不同嘛....而且你也是有好处哒，别人看不到你的，而且也伤害不到你，那你就能安然无恙啦。”
沐梓丞眉头一挑很是不悦的说道：“吾不觉得，她死了吾不也跟着一起吗！”
昔小苑一脸的不爽的说道：“喂！你这人怎么这样啊，你以为我想跟你一起啊，问题是有的选吗。”
content_en:
Xi Xiaoyuan and Mu Zicheng have already teleported to the world. Xi Xiaoyuan opened his eyes and scanned the surrounding environment. This was an antique room. A wisp of smoke slowly rose from the room, and it was fragrant. This should be aromatherapy.
As soon as Mu Zicheng arrived here, he had an ominous premonition... Xi Xiaoyuan sat on the bed, and then looked at Mu Zicheng carefully. He was wearing light blue clothes. The clothes were so beautiful and had a fluttery feeling. The crown on his hair was so delicate~ It was silver-white, with a light blue gem in the middle, which was beautiful and beautiful.
Based on the current dog leash situation that makes people feel dreamy and unbelievable... This man looks like an ancient person at first glance, but his skin is so tender, and he looks so... Xi Xiaoyuan's mouth is watering, a pure natural beauty, he is really a handsome man.
Ouch~ She almost burst out of her mouth when she looked at it.
Mu Zicheng felt a lewd gaze, and saw Xi Xiaoyuan looking at him like a gangster on the street, and her saliva was almost drooling. This woman must be too lewd.
Mu Zicheng looked at Xi Xiaoyuan with a cold expression and said, "Have you seen enough? He looks so vulgar."
Xi Xiaoyuan rolled his eyes and said, "Which dynasty are you from?"
Mu Zicheng said: "I came to Fuze Continent, and I haven't asked you which country you are from."
Xi Xiaoyuan suddenly raised his head and said proudly: "I come from an era of advanced technology. I have never heard of the Fuze Continent you mentioned."
Mu Zicheng looked confused, then looked at Xi Xiaoyuan's clothes speechlessly and said, "Technology is advanced? What kind of world is this? And you are really wearing these clothes, don't look at anything inappropriate."
Xi Xiaoyuan looked at his dress and saw that there was nothing wrong with it, but for an ancient man like him, it was quite a problem.
"This is called fashion, and you won't understand it anyway."
Mu Zicheng said with a look of disgust: "I don't want to understand the fashion of a commoner like you."
Xi Xiaoyuan sighed and said, "Okay, we're either in the same world or there's a generation gap. I'll let you see our world if I get the chance. Anyway, it's very, very powerful..."
Mu Zicheng raised his eyebrows and said, "Is that so? I'm still interested to see how powerful you are~"
Xi Xiaoyuan said with a stern expression: "I promise to open your eyes..."
"Character implantation begins..."
The system suddenly said something silently, and Xi Xiaoyuan began to change. Her dress turned into an antique dress, and her hair was tied up. Xi Xiaoyuan ran to the bronze mirror and took a look at herself.
There is a white crown on her hair, and it is embellished with green emeralds. The hair is neatly tied, and the clothes feel good, soft and comfortable, and the design is very beautiful. The color of the clothes is emerald green, except for some parts of the collar, which are white, and the patterns on the clothes are monotonous, beautiful, and elegant.
Great! Xi Xiaoyuan turned around in front of the bronze mirror.
Mu Zicheng suddenly said: "You are so beautiful, but you look ugly no matter how you look at her."
Xi Xiaoyuan glared at him with a cold look and said, "You're ugly, be careful. I'll just kick you over. The fact that we can do tasks together shows that we are destined, and we will have to do many tasks together in the future. So we are partners now. As a partner, don't you have to cultivate some moral integrity?!"
Mu Zicheng said "cut" and ignored Xi Xiaoyuan, but Xi Xiaoyuan found that Mu Zicheng had no shadow... Let me go, what's going on with him, and she found that there was no trace of him in the bronze mirror.
Xi Xiaoyuan stuttered a little and said: "You...you have no shadow, and you can't be seen in the mirror...I go, you are a ghost~ Am I going to do tasks with...people without shadows?" ! "
Xi Xiaoyuan felt cold.
Mu Zicheng suddenly turned his head and stared at Xi coldly.Xiaoyuan took one look, frowned and immediately walked to the mirror to take a look. Really, he couldn't be seen in the mirror, only the woman next to him.
Mu Zicheng shouted to the people around him in a bad tone: "Manager of time and space, come out!!"
The system appeared and immediately explained: "Don't worry, don't worry, I know what you want to ask. Your body has suffered a certain amount of damage because of the consumption of mana, so this system cannot give you a false identity, and this is only temporary."
Xi Xiaoyuan secretly smiled beside him when he heard what the system said.
Mu Zicheng glanced at Xi Xiaoyuan coldly. When Xi Xiaoyuan saw Mu Zicheng looking at her so fiercely, she made a face to Mu Zicheng, as if she was gloating about his misfortune.
Mu Zicheng looked at the system coldly, as if he wanted to eat it and said, "Why does she have it?"
The system laughed and said: "You two are in different situations...and you have advantages. Others can't see you, and they can't hurt you, so you will be safe and sound."
Mu Zicheng raised his brows and said displeasedly: "I don't think I will follow her when she dies!"
Xi Xiaoyuan said with an unhappy look on his face: "Hey! Why are you like this? Do you think I want to be with you? The question is, are there any options?"
